coordinate_convention: pixels; image x right, y down; polygons TL/TR/BR/BL; undirected long-axis angle modulo 180 degrees
annotator: independent visual inspection before detector overlays
source_geometry_note: User corrected full stack to 10 layers of 6x6=360 bricks and confirmed layers removed between views. References describe visible surfaces, not forced full-layer counts. Five complete brick-length groups per visible strip were visually counted in selected views.
scope: Only individual exposed visual top faces are positive targets. This is not proof of mechanical gripper accessibility or robot-frame pose.
ambiguity_policy: Orange regions excluded from positive scoring and ignored for spurious detections on overlap. Lower-layer regions are a non-exhaustive set of visible fragments; conservative false-target checks only.
correlation_policy: A:img1-6; B:img7-9; C:img10-12; D:img13-18. Repeated views are correlated; no random train/test split or independent-generalization claim.
